items.title: JPMorgan screens well on value factor as bank P/E multiples compress
items.snippet: JPM's trailing P/E of 11.2x and price-to-book of 1.8x place it in the 70th percentile on value among large-cap financial peers, reflecting sector-wide multiple compression after the March rate volatility.

items.title: Short interest in JPM ticks higher to 1.5% of float
items.snippet: Bearish positioning on JPMorgan has edged up modestly, with days-to-cover rising to 1.2, though levels remain well below the 3%+ threshold that typically signals crowded shorts in financials.

items.title: Why JPM's grey-zone Altman Z-score is not a distress signal
items.snippet: Large banks structurally score in the grey zone on Altman Z'' due to their leverage-heavy balance sheets and low working capital ratios. JPM's 1.82 score is consistent with its well-capitalized peers and does not indicate financial distress.
